text: He threw a thousand dinars into the sea, and it arrived.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us of a man who borrowed it, with only Allah as his witness.
No boat came. So he sealed the money in a piece of wood, and gave it to Allah.
On the other shore, the lender found the wood... and his money inside.
Can't keep a promise with your own hands? Keep it with Allah. Full movie below.
